<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Gevurah cuts away the glitter that would hide the path, while the Awtsmoos creates every boundary from nothing beneath; Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when each beautiful idea survives the blade and keeps its breath.
-->
# Phase Two — Twenty Corrections

1. Do not create a second asset-upload system.
2. Do not duplicate file inputs if existing event wiring can be reused.
3. Do not infer frame/reference mode in a way that surprises the user.
4. Do not hide text-only generation behind an image requirement.
5. Do not turn images into decorative thumbnails too small to judge.
6. Do not place critical Replace/Remove actions only on hover; mobile has no hover.
7. Do not animate blur or layout dimensions.
8. Do not add pointer-tracking JavaScript for decoration.
9. Do not add permanent explanatory paragraphs to the main path.
10. Do not expose API/provider jargon ahead of creative language.
11. Do not regress reusable-asset replacement propagation.
12. Do not leave stale object URLs after replacement.
13. Do not allow removed media to survive in outgoing payloads.
14. Do not break first/last/reference role mapping.
15. Do not break prompt node identity/focus when media changes.
16. Do not increase first-screen vertical density with more cards.
17. Do not modify provider/API files unless inspection finds an actual contract issue.
18. Do not touch generated assets or bundles.
19. Do not accept any touched source file above 120 lines; split real responsibilities instead.
20. Do not push until the new media-first body and the previous five browser regressions all pass together.
